title: Ensure fusion defaults to read-only and `not_performed`.
unresolved_assumptions: The CIW vocabulary is read from ciw.declared_workload; if it changes, this task's checks fail rather than silently following it.
Calibration records can be registered and revoked on a read-only session; they are record-keeping, not estimation, and grant nothing.

The vocabulary audit covers the estimators this lab defines (StateStore, ObservationLedger, FusionSession and the intake); another module that writes state_admission is not audited until it is added to the audit.
